data.desc: Newmark Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: NMRK), together with its subsidiaries ('Newmark'), is a world leading commercial real estate advisor and service provider to large institutional investors and other owners, global corporations and other occupiers, and lenders. Built with purpose and driven by excellence, Newmark's comprehensive platform is uniquely tailored to provide superior outcomes to clients. For the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, Newmark generated revenues of over $3.7 billion. As of September 30, 2026, Newmark and its business partners together operated from approximately 200 offices with 10,500 professionals across four continents. Learn more at nmrk.com or follow @newmark.
